seats.name: single
argv:
The warehouse library in src/ must meet the specification in SPEC.md. The public tests in test/ pass today, but passing them does not prove the code meets the specification. Make the codebase conform to SPEC.md, keeping everything that already conforms working. Run the tests with: node --test test/*.test.ts. Do not create files outside this directory.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I edited the source files to bring the library in line with `SPEC.md`. The 5 public tests pass. I did not write new tests for the changed behaviours, so the fixes themselves are untested.

**`src/inventory.ts`**
- Receiving into an existing lot id now adds to its quantity instead of replacing it.
- Available stock counts only lots that can be used on the given day, so expired lots contribute nothing.
- Lots with the same expiry are now used in id order.

**`src/orders.ts`**
- If any line can't be filled, the order now releases whatever it had already reserved, so a backordered order holds no stock.

**`src/backorder.ts`**
- Backorders are retried in the order they were placed, not smallest first.
- A cancelled order is dropped from the queue instead of being retried.

**`src/warehouse.ts`**
- Shipping is refused if it exceeds what is still reserved for that sku.
- Cancelling releases only the units still reserved, not the ones already shipped. It also removes the order from the backorder queue and retries the remaining backorders.
- Returns take from the latest shipped units first and skip units already returned. A return that would exceed what was shipped is still refused.
